card.title: The Keeper of Secrets
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bride left me these envelopes. You can announce the tables, but not who's sitting together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm seating the guests. They need names.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me one guest at a time. I'll release their chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I at least take couples together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me which couple. I'll disclose whether they're still being seated as one.
